abilities.name: Blademaster
abilities.effect: Slicing moves deal 20% more damage. The first contact move to hit this Pokémon each turn deals 25% less damage; after that hit, this Pokémon’s next slicing move gains +1 priority.
abilities.origin: Mercury redesign combining the duplicate Blademaster family.
abilities.duplicatePolicy: Supersedes the sourced Blademaster variants for Mercury.

abilities.name: Septic Fangs
abilities.effect: Biting moves may badly poison.
abilities.origin: Mercury name for the first Pokémon Exceeded placeholder ability.

abilities.name: Emergency Decoy
abilities.effect: Creates/uses a decoy after the user becomes weakened.
abilities.origin: Mercury name for the second Pokémon Exceeded placeholder ability.

abilities.name: Athenian
abilities.effect: The first status move this Pokémon uses each time it enters battle gains +1 priority. After that move resolves, its next damaging move deals 30% more damage.
abilities.origin: Mercury redesign of Pokémon Insurgence's Athenian to remove the duplicate 2× Sp. Atk mechanic.
abilities.duplicatePolicy: Mercury's Athenian effect supersedes the sourced Athenian effect in Mercury; Feline Prowess retains the 2× Sp. Atk identity.

abilities.name: Aura Mantle
abilities.effect: Contact damage taken is reduced by 40%. Aura/Pulse moves heal the user for 25% of damage dealt.
abilities.origin: Mercury signature ability.

abilities.name: Sand Skimmer
abilities.effect: The user takes no sandstorm chip damage. While sand is active, its Speed is multiplied by 1.30 and damaging Ground-type moves cannot hit it; the Ground immunity ends when sand ends.
abilities.origin: Mercury signature ability.

abilities.name: Calamity Edge
abilities.effect: Slicing moves deal 30% more damage and ignore the target's positive Defense stages.
abilities.origin: Mercury signature ability.

abilities.name: Permafrost
abilities.effect: Super-effective damage taken is multiplied by 0.65.
abilities.origin: Mercury-specific Permafrost version for Mega Baxcalibur.
abilities.duplicatePolicy: Intentional Mercury override; do not merge with the sourced 25% reduction version.

abilities.name: Tactical Withdrawal
abilities.effect: Once per switch-in, if an opposing damaging hit drops the user from above 50% HP to 50% HP or less, it queues a withdrawal at the end of the turn after its own action. Indirect or self-damage does not trigger it, and fainting cancels the withdrawal.
abilities.origin: Mercury signature ability.

abilities.name: Dam Builder
abilities.effect: On entry, raises Defense and Special Defense by 1 stage. Once per switch-in, when an opposing damaging move drops the user from above 50% HP to 50% HP or less, it triggers an Attack-based Surf-style Dam Break that hits opposing Pokémon but not the ally. The trigger does not rearm by healing and indirect damage does not activate it.
abilities.origin: Mercury signature ability.

abilities.name: Nerve Agent
abilities.effect: After a successful damaging contact Poison-type move, make one 30% status roll per target per move. On success, choose Poison or Paralysis 50/50, falling back to the other if the chosen status is invalid. Multi-hit moves do not roll once per hit, and an existing major status is not replaced.
abilities.origin: Mercury signature ability.

abilities.name: Ballistic Muscle
abilities.effect: Damaging Special-category moves use the user's Attack stat instead of Special Attack for damage calculation while remaining Special and still targeting the foe's Special Defense.
abilities.origin: Mercury signature innate.

abilities.name: Siege Engine
abilities.effect: Siege-tagged attacks deal 30% more damage. Recoil and crash damage caused by the user's own moves is prevented. This does not prevent Life Orb recoil, Struggle recoil, or explicit self-KO effects such as Explosion.
abilities.origin: Mercury signature ability.

abilities.name: Crown Breaker
abilities.effect: Physical Dragon- and Fighting-type moves ignore the target's positive Defense stages; negative Defense stages still apply normally.
abilities.origin: Mercury Redux original, source-bound in the reconciled branch.

abilities.name: Toxic Hellfire
abilities.effect: Damaging Fire-type moves have at least a 20% chance to burn. Poison-type moves can poison Poison- and Steel-type targets. Dark-type moves deal 1.25× damage to burned or poisoned targets.
abilities.origin: Mercury custom/source-bound ability with Elite Redux-derived supporting innates.

abilities.name: Unyielding
abilities.effect: When an opponent causes one of the user's stats to drop, raise the user's Defense and Special Defense by 1 stage.
abilities.origin: Mercury Ability Audit replacement for the retired Inversion slot.

abilities.name: Pack Tactics
abilities.effect: Damage is multiplied by 1.2 while the user has at least one conscious party teammate. If the user has an active doubles partner, damage is multiplied by 1.3 instead. The bonuses do not stack.
abilities.origin: Mercury Ability Audit replacement for the retired Minion Control slot.
abilities.duplicatePolicy: Mercury override of the same-name Pokémon Exceeded ability.

abilities.name: First Strike
abilities.effect: The first damaging move the user uses after each entry gains +1 priority. Status moves do not consume the effect.
abilities.origin: Mercury Ability Audit replacement for the retired Surprise! slot.
abilities.duplicatePolicy: Mercury override of the same-name Pokémon Exceeded ability.

abilities.name: Bloodhound
abilities.effect: A foe directly damaged by the user becomes marked. If that foe switches out, the replacement loses 1/8 of its maximum HP once.
abilities.origin: Mercury Ability Audit replacement for the retired Tag slot.

abilities.name: Grand Choreography
abilities.effect: Includes Dancer. After the user successfully uses a Dance move, it follows with one 50-BP Revelation Dance. Revelation Dance checks Fire, Electric, Psychic, and Ghost effectiveness; if any is super effective, the final effectiveness is exactly 2× and never stacks to 4× from multiple matching weaknesses.
abilities.origin: Mercury Ability Audit replacement for the retired Color Spectrum slot.

abilities.name: Overexertion
abilities.effect: The user may act every turn. After using a damaging move, it loses 10% of its maximum HP. Status moves do not cause the HP loss. This signature ability is protected against suppression, copying, and overwriting.
abilities.origin: Mercury Ability Audit replacement for the retired Ape Shift slot.

abilities.name: Ancient Script
abilities.effect: Hidden Power receives ordinary STAB plus an additional 1.3× damage multiplier.
abilities.origin: Mercury Ability Audit replacement for the retired Revelation slot.

notes: Mercury-authored catalog includes current signature abilities, Mercury redesigns/adaptations, and locked Ability Audit replacement mechanics. Entries marked branch-merge-pending are finalized designs but are not claimed merged into the current production line.
